why: Rhenium is recovered from the roaster flue dust of molybdenum concentrate, so the two metals leave the same plants.
condition: Rhenium recovery stays tied to molybdenum roasting rather than dedicated circuits.
falsifier: Rhenium supply decouples from molybdenum throughput.

why: Refining catalysts and superalloys draw the same nickel units, so demand strength on one side tightens the other.
condition: Both sides buy nickel at index-linked prices.
falsifier: One side is fully hedged or substitutes away.

why: Transformer and cable windings are a first-order copper demand line into the same mine and smelter stack.
condition: Grid and data center buildout remains copper intensive.
falsifier: Aluminium substitution takes the winding share.

why: Furnace graphite and battery anodes compete for the same high purity graphite capacity and the same export licence regime.
condition: Chinese export policy treats both products comparably.
falsifier: Licences separate the two product lines.

why: Hafnium is the twin of zirconium in the same separation step, so nuclear cladding and blade coatings share a feed.
condition: Zirconium and hafnium continue to be split at the same plants.
falsifier: Cladding moves to alternative materials.

why: SF6 and HFO refrigerants both start from fluorspar and hydrofluoric acid, so one mineral chain feeds both nodes.
condition: Fluorine chemistry remains the route for both products.
falsifier: Alternative chemistries displace one side.

why: Semiconductor crucibles and optical fiber preforms draw on the same high purity silica deposits.
condition: Both industries keep needing the same grade of silica.
falsifier: Synthetic silica displaces natural quartz on one side.

why: Crystal growth, fiber drawing and fab processes share the rare gas supply.
condition: Helium and rare gas supply stays tight.
falsifier: Recovery projects loosen the market.

why: Battery foil is another copper demand line competing for cathode supply.
condition: Foil demand grows with storage deployment.
falsifier: Alternative current collectors take share.

why: Catalyst and magnet rare earths come from the same separation lines, so demand from one raises cost for the other.
condition: La and Ce separation capacity is shared with the heavy rare earth circuits.
falsifier: Dedicated catalyst grade lines absorb the demand.

why: Skilled trades and foundry labour compete for the same apprenticeship pool.
condition: Both sectors hire from the same training pipeline.
falsifier: Programmes expand to cover both.

why: The cooling load node is a sub-mechanism of the data center site node, written at its own resolution.
condition: Cooling load remains a material share of site engineering.
falsifier: Cooling becomes a minor design line.

why: Firm nuclear capacity is contracted directly by data center operators.
condition: Behind the meter and PPA structures keep growing.
falsifier: Operators return to grid supply only.

why: Molybdenum is a byproduct of porphyry copper mines, so the catalyst input hangs off the copper node.
condition: Byproduct recovery stays economical.
falsifier: Molybdenum becomes a primary mining product.

why: The dig is the resolution beneath the anchor node.
condition: The anchor node remains the mechanism of record.
falsifier: The dig contradicts the anchor and the anchor is updated.

why: Turbine slots are a concrete case of the capacity constraint mechanism.
condition: Capacity constraint remains the governing mechanism.
falsifier: Another bottleneck explains the same slips.

why: Interregional transfer sits inside the interconnection bottleneck.
condition: Transfer additions remain gated by the bottleneck.
falsifier: Transfer capacity expands freely.

why: Storage is flexible capacity inside the constraint mechanism.
condition: Storage remains the marginal flexible resource.
falsifier: Other flexibility dominates.

why: Power electronics gate converter and inverter delivery.
condition: Semiconductors remain on the critical path.
falsifier: Inventories cover project schedules durably.

why: Magnet makers are the expression layer the supplier basket watches.
condition: The basket remains the traded surface.
falsifier: The expression changes instrument.

why: Cooling load growth is the force behind the cooling bottleneck.
condition: Density growth continues.
falsifier: Cooling stops binding site schedules.

why: Switchgear shares the critical path with transformers.
condition: Both remain gated by the same equipment complex.
falsifier: Switchgear lead times decouple from transformer lead times.

why: Interconnect is a sub-node of the data center site.
condition: Compute growth keeps pulling fiber.
falsifier: Compute stops needing new interconnect.

why: Crews are the concrete form of the labor bottleneck.
condition: Labour remains a binding constraint in the regions of the buildout.
falsifier: Crew supply clears and equipment becomes the only constraint.

why: Grid and data center copper is a demand line inside the copper factor.
condition: The factor remains the market reference.
falsifier: Contract structures decouple physical from factor.

why: Firm power additions are a capacity constraint case.
condition: Firm power remains the binding commitment for load growth.
falsifier: Firm obligations loosen.

why: Catalyst supply is a materials constraint case under the same mechanism.
condition: Catalyst supply remains a material constraint for refiners.
